audit.method: Read original Svelte APIs/bodies and frozen React APIs/bodies plus implementation task handoffs. The bounded review below does not classify the rest by filename or existence. Active and later changes are excluded.

statusDefinitions.unmapped: No source-to-target API correspondence reviewed in this ledger. A target may already exist; this is not a claim it is absent.
statusDefinitions.partial: A correspondence was inspected, but the per-source contract audit is incomplete or a named implementation gap remains.
statusDefinitions.implemented: The stated local source contract is present in the inspected target implementation. This is code review only, not passing functional or visual evidence and not migration acceptance.

evidencePolicy.planned: A scene-manifest definition at manifestCommit names the exact source. It has not been executed or accepted by this audit. Functional IDs combine component and fixture; visual IDs are manifest parity IDs.
evidencePolicy.passed: Only a separately reviewed real run naming exact reference and candidate revisions, case and artifact may be entered. One case does not accept a whole source.
evidencePolicy.failed: A separately reviewed real run failed at the recorded revisions. Keep its artifact and gap; do not replace it with a planned case to hide failure.
evidencePolicy.historicalRuns: Task handoff claims were used for ownership/provenance only; historical passing runs are not promoted to this candidate.
evidencePolicy.maintenance: Review and edit this ledger separately. The status command never writes it or updates the immutable inventory. If refreshing audit.candidateCommit, recheck all recorded target hashes against that commit. Preserve exact inventory keys and denominator; added incoming sources remain drift until a separately reviewed inventory decision.

limits: Mapped targets are the inspected implementation and selected direct assets, not a transitive dependency graph.
Source/API coverage and planned evidence are separate. No source is marked accepted or ported.
All 1430 original view units, including previews/test hosts, remain in the denominator; the other 460 records are supporting source files.
Catalog, display and native-browser components do not establish full application routing, daemon workflows or Electron cutover.
No user-facing released behavior changes; no assistant-guide update is required for this internal inventory tool.

foundation.scope: Core control public API correspondence; native ref/event and motion semantics require scoped execution evidence.

collection.scope: Collection selection/virtualization public API and task handoff, including the committed keyboard focus correction.

confirm.scope: Form/content dialog prop surfaces and lifecycle handoff; no cross-framework modal behavior accepted here.

catalog.scope: Catalog controls, page routing, fixtures and shell source correspondence; explicit partial shell and avatar fixtures.

media.scope: Media overlay and zoom public API, including committed portal event containment fix.

lightboxes.scope: Image/video composition API and task provenance; audit candidate pins actual files, no historical run accepted.

local-editor.scope: TipTap node-view and suggestion/mention public API and callback ownership.

questions-attachments.scope: Wizard draft/completion/imperative-focus and local attachment presentation APIs; neutral type extraction is reported as source drift.

textarea-consumers.scope: Autosave and MCP JSON callback component APIs and implementation handoff.

replace-agent.scope: Replace-agent modal body and callback API; not a domain mutation or live agent journey.

directory-view.scope: Controlled directory picker callback surface and source error/navigation state API.

directory-live.scope: Live directory modal API and shared factory handoff. No actual host journey accepted by this audit.

structural.scope: ButtonGroup component and extracted CSS were inspected against the original Svelte orientation/group contract.

coordinator-controls.scope: CopyInput, PrincipalAvatar and GrokLogo were coordinator-authored; no separate implementation task ID was established. The task ID identifies this audit.

coordinator-patterns.scope: Form, screen and static collection patterns were coordinator-authored; no separate implementation task ID was established. The task ID identifies this audit.

catalog-expansion.scope: Partial avatar fixture source/target body inspected. Later presence/color fixture completions are outside the frozen candidate.
